characters.continuity: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them (Film Series)
characters.summary: As an Obscurial, Credence transforms into a massive, destructive, swirling black tempest of dark energy capable of tearing apart physical structures and overpowering multiple aurors simultaneously.

mechanisms: Discorporation into a fast-moving, elusive cloud of dark energy
Immunity to standard physical attacks while in Obscurus form

weaknesses: Vulnerable to emotional calming or persuasion when attempting to return to human form
Destruction of the host body results in death if the Obscurus is forcibly separated
limitations: Untisured and chaotic, lacking fine tactical control
Shortened lifespan due to the parasitic nature of the Obscurus
characters.formDifferences: Transforms from a repressed human wizard into a volatile, swirling entity of pure dark destructive energy.

sources.supports: Obscurial powers, abilities, and notable feats across the film series.
